title: The blank button
body: The annex at night. The elevator panel has eleven numbers and a warmth where a twelfth would be. A work order in your pocket is the only key the map does not have. The service channel clicks. ‘Operator,’ M. says, less formally than the memos. ‘Elevators develop aspirations. We do not encourage them. Your job description ends at eleven.’

outcome.text: ‘I was hoping you would be more boring,’ M. says. The car rises past 11 without slowing. The display still says 11. The doors are thinking about it.

choices.label: Take the stairs back to the desk. Not tonight.

outcome.text: ‘Good,’ M. says too quickly. ‘That was almost a conversation.’ The work order is still in your pocket. The zone will wait. The system prefers that.
